description: List the people in your network with their role, company, relationship and the other names they go by. Pass query to find someone by name or alias (any case, part of a name), company to list the people at one company (exact name, any case), and the cursor a page ends with to read the next one.

company.description: Only the people at this company, e.g. Acme

cursor.description: The cursor the previous page ended with, to read the next page

query.description: Part of a name or alias, e.g. jp or proff

name: list_people
